🚨 Third #HMPV Case Confirmed in Gujarat, #India🚨

A two-month-old infant in Ahmedabad has tested positive for #humanmetapneumovirus.

The Indian Council of Medical Research (#ICMR) confirms the diagnosis.

Authorities urge public vigilance

🚨 Third #HMPV Case Confirmed in Gujarat, #India🚨

A two-month-old infant in Ahmedabad has tested positive for #humanmetapneumovirus.

The Indian Council of Medical Research (#ICMR) confirms the diagnosis.

Authorities urge public vigilance and adherence to health advisories.
